mapper.update: UPDATE afv_comfyui_test_run SET prompt_id = #{promptId}, request_json = #{request}, submitted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE job_id = #{id} AND submitted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT job_id FROM afv_comfyui_test_run WHERE job_id = #{id} AND prompt_id = #{promptId} AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND acknowledged_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_comfyui_test_run SET acknowledged_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE job_id = #{id}
UPDATE afv_comfyui_test_run SET poll_attempts = poll_attempts + 1, consecutive_errors = CASE WHEN #{error} IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE consecutive_errors + 1 END WHERE job_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_comfyui_test_run WHERE job_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
